lead.headline: USCIS in focus: deference, EADs and the 60-day grace period
lead.deck: Three DHS/USCIS Federal Register documents (Sept. 11 and Oct. 14, 2026) remain open and require reading the text before advising clients.
body: The published titles are “Eliminating the Discretionary 60-Day Grace Period” (8 CFR Parts 204 and 214), “Removing Deference to Prior USCIS Determinations of Eligibility,” and “Removal of Automatic Extensions for Certain Employment Authorization Documents.” The full texts were not re-read for this issue; final status, effective dates and comment deadlines must be checked in the official documents.

deadlines: 11/09: comments close on the OPT fee. 11/13: comments close on ending deference (I-129) and the refugee interim rule.
11/16: deadline to claim prejudice to ICE regarding the ratified civil penalties. 12/07: comments close on I-90 and the OPT information collection.
This week: December Visa Bulletin, new BIA precedents and FLAG notices. Official source: FLAG ↗

lead.headline: USCIS em pauta: deferência, EAD e período de graça de 60 dias
lead.deck: Três atos do DHS/USCIS no Federal Register (11/09 e 14/10/2026) seguem abertos e exigem leitura do texto antes de orientar clientes.
body: Os títulos publicados são “Eliminating the Discretionary 60-Day Grace Period” (8 CFR partes 204 e 214), “Removing Deference to Prior USCIS Determinations of Eligibility” e “Removal of Automatic Extensions for Certain Employment Authorization Documents”. Nesta edição os textos integrais não foram relidos; status final, datas de vigência e prazos de comentários devem ser conferidos nos documentos oficiais.

deadlines: 09/11: encerram os comentários sobre a taxa de OPT. 13/11: encerram os comentários sobre o fim da deferência (I-129) e a regra interina de refugiados.
16/11: prazo para alegar prejuízo ao ICE quanto às multas civis ratificadas. 07/12: encerram os comentários sobre I-90 e a coleta de informação do OPT.
Esta semana: Visa Bulletin de dezembro, novos precedentes do BIA e avisos do FLAG. Fonte oficial: FLAG ↗
